transcript: Speaker A: Stop using your keyboard to type and do this instead. Whisper Flow is four times faster than typing and it formats all of my scripts. And just like that, you can write any note, email, or text with no typing needed and perfect formatting. Try Whisper Flow for free today.

summary: The presenter showcases Whisper Flow, a voice-to-text tool that formats scripts, notes, and emails automatically. He highlights its speed and convenience over manual typing. The video ends with a call to action to try the app for free.
